intent: Review workspace storage usage in Account cleanup before deciding which accounts to suspend.
actions: Start as a signed-in root administrator on Tenant Subscription Management, with small workspace containing one 13,858-byte JPEG and empty workspace containing no photos; both are cleanup candidates under the chosen limits.
Open Clean up accounts and wait for Account cleanup to appear.
Set Max storage (MB) to 1, wait for both workspace candidate rows, and compare their Content values.
